healthcareSystem: High-quality healthcare system funded through social security contributions. One main hospital (Hospital Nostra Senyora de Meritxell) and several clinics. Uses 112 but is NOT an EU/EEA member.
qualityNotes: Excellent healthcare for a microstate. Hospital Nostra Senyora de Meritxell is modern and well-equipped. For highly specialized procedures, patients are transferred to Barcelona or Toulouse. Many doctors trained in Spain or France.
pharmacyHours: Pharmacies open 9am-1pm and 3pm-7pm weekdays. Rotating 24-hour duty pharmacy (farmacia de guardia) system.
pharmacyTips: Well-stocked pharmacies throughout the country. Staff typically speak Catalan, Spanish, and French. Duty pharmacy info posted on all pharmacy doors. Medications may be cheaper than in France or Spain.
prescriptionRules: Prescription required for antibiotics and most medications. EU/Spanish/French prescriptions generally accepted. Pharmacists can advise on OTC alternatives.

restrictedMeds.name: Cannabis/CBD products
restrictedMeds.note: Illegal in Andorra despite proximity to more liberal neighbors.

restrictedMeds.name: Strong opioids
restrictedMeds.note: Carry prescription and doctor's letter. Keep in original packaging.

bringDocumentation: Carry prescriptions and a doctor's letter for all medications. Documentation in Catalan, Spanish, French, or English is understood. Keep medications in original packaging.

travelInsurance.tips: European Health Insurance Card (EHIC) is NOT valid in Andorra — it is not in the EU/EEA. Private travel insurance is strongly recommended. Ski/winter sports coverage is essential if visiting for skiing.

recommended: Tick-borne encephalitis (if hiking in forested areas)
vaccinations.notes: No special vaccinations needed. Standard European health precautions apply. Altitude sickness possible at higher elevations for sensitive individuals.

waterNotes: Tap water is safe to drink throughout Andorra. Mountain spring water is excellent quality.
foodSafetyTips: Food safety standards are high, comparable to France and Spain. Enjoy local cuisine without concern. Restaurant hygiene is well-regulated.
medicalTourismNote: Andorra is known for affordable dental care and some cosmetic procedures. Prices are lower than France while maintaining high quality standards.
metaDescription: Health guide for Andorra. Hospital info, ski injury tips, pharmacy access, EHIC not valid, and why travel insurance matters in this Pyrenean microstate.

hospitals.name: Hospital Nostra Senyora de Meritxell
hospitals.notes: Main and only hospital. Modern facility with emergency department. English spoken by many staff. Handles ski injuries frequently.

On és la farmàcia més propera?

dentalCare.availability: Several private dental clinics with modern equipment. Popular for dental tourism from France.
dentalCare.costRange: $50-200 USD for basic procedures, 30-50% less than France
dentalCare.notes: High-quality dental care at lower prices than neighboring countries. Many dentists trained in Spain or France.
dentalCare.emergencyTip: Hospital Nostra Senyora de Meritxell has emergency dental services. Private clinics offer same-day appointments.

mentalHealth.internationalLine: Crisis Text Line: text HOME to 741741 (US-based)
mentalHealth.englishTherapists: Limited but available. Many therapists speak Spanish, French, and some English.
mentalHealth.notes: Mental health services available but limited for a small country. Telehealth may be the best option for English-speaking tourists needing support.

accessibilityInfo.overview: Andorra has been improving accessibility but the mountainous terrain presents challenges.
accessibilityInfo.hospitalAccess: Hospital is fully wheelchair accessible with modern facilities.
accessibilityInfo.transport: Public buses have some accessibility features. Steep streets in old town areas are difficult for wheelchair users.
accessibilityInfo.tips: Ski resorts have adapted skiing programs. Request accessible rooms in advance. Cable cars and gondolas may have accessibility limitations.

covidStatus.entryRequirements: No COVID testing or vaccination requirements for entry as of 2026.
covidStatus.maskPolicy: No mask mandates. May be requested in healthcare facilities.
covidStatus.testing: Testing available at Hospital Nostra Senyora de Meritxell and private clinics.
covidStatus.notes: Follow the same precautions as for France/Spain travel.

insuranceClaimProcess: Hospital and clinics accept major credit cards. Obtain itemized receipts with diagnosis codes. EHIC is NOT valid — you must pay and claim from private insurance. Keep all documentation for reimbursement.

commonCosts.note: Costs are moderate by European standards. Lower than France, comparable to Spain. Payment expected at time of service for tourists.

medicalEvacuation.note: Barcelona is about 2.5 hours by road. Helicopter evacuation available for ski injuries and emergencies. Transfer to Spanish or French hospitals is routine for complex cases.

drugNameMap.note: Widely available. Same brands as Spain.
